<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:bpmndi="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/DI" xmlns:dc="http://www.omg.org/spec/DD/20100524/DC" xmlns:di="http://www.omg.org/spec/DD/20100524/DI" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" xmlns:camunda="http://camunda.org/schema/1.0/bpmn" id="Definitions_1" targetNamespace="http://bpmn.io/schema/bpmn" exporter="@bpmnkit/core" exporterVersion="0.0.23">
  <bpmn:process id="KycOnboarding" camunda:versionTag="1.0.0" name="KYC Onboarding Process" isExecutable="true">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="start" name="Customer Onboarding Started">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_xMEWWQ9P</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="uploadDocument" name="Upload Identity Document">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_xMEWWQ9P</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_8reekDVI</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_aFggSXlz</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="verifyDocument" camunda:type="external" camunda:topic="io.camunda:http-json:1" name="Verify Document (OCR)">
      <bpmn:extensionElements>
        <camunda:inputOutput>
          <camunda:inputParameter name="authentication.type">bearer</camunda:inputParameter>
          <camunda:inputParameter name="authentication.token">=secrets.OCR_SERVICE_TOKEN</camunda:inputParameter>
          <camunda:inputParameter name="method">POST</camunda:inputParameter>
          <camunda:inputParameter name="url">=ocrServiceUrl + "/verify"</camunda:inputParameter>
          <camunda:inputParameter name="body">={ documentId: documentId, documentType: documentType }</camunda:inputParameter>
          <camunda:inputParameter name="connectionTimeoutInSeconds">20</camunda:inputParameter>
          <camunda:inputParameter name="readTimeoutInSeconds">20</camunda:inputParameter>
        </camunda:inputOutput>
      </bpmn:extensionElements>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_aFggSXlz</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_nrWGBeCZ</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="qualityGateway" name="Document Verified?" default="Flow_RETXa3Vt">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_nrWGBeCZ</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Vp0HOfCz</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_RETXa3Vt</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:scriptTask id="incrementRetry" name="Increment Retry Count">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_RETXa3Vt</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_i4OMbS2y</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:scriptTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="retryGateway" name="Retries Remaining?" default="Flow_Y4q86h1Q">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_i4OMbS2y</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_8reekDVI</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Y4q86h1Q</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="sendVerificationRejection" camunda:type="external" camunda:topic="email-sender" name="Send Rejection Notice">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Y4q86h1Q</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_VNppp5Gg</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="endRejectedVerification" name="Rejected — Verification Failed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_VNppp5Gg</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="screening" camunda:type="external" camunda:topic="io.camunda:http-json:1" name="Sanctions & PEP Screening">
      <bpmn:extensionElements>
        <camunda:inputOutput>
          <camunda:inputParameter name="authentication.type">bearer</camunda:inputParameter>
          <camunda:inputParameter name="authentication.token">=secrets.SCREENING_SERVICE_TOKEN</camunda:inputParameter>
          <camunda:inputParameter name="method">POST</camunda:inputParameter>
          <camunda:inputParameter name="url">=screeningServiceUrl + "/screen"</camunda:inputParameter>
          <camunda:inputParameter name="body">={ fullName: applicant.fullName, dateOfBirth: applicant.dateOfBirth, nationality: applicant.nationality }</camunda:inputParameter>
          <camunda:inputParameter name="connectionTimeoutInSeconds">20</camunda:inputParameter>
          <camunda:inputParameter name="readTimeoutInSeconds">20</camunda:inputParameter>
        </camunda:inputOutput>
      </bpmn:extensionElements>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Vp0HOfCz</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_8ZqbzajU</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="dueDiligenceGateway" name="Due Diligence Level?" default="Flow_LXaUZMEX">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_8ZqbzajU</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_hyodCBEu</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_LXaUZMEX</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="standardDueDiligence" camunda:type="external" camunda:topic="due-diligence-service" name="Standard Due Diligence">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_hyodCBEu</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Fj3alEoq</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>
    <bpmn:userTask id="complianceReview" name="Enhanced Due Diligence Review">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_LXaUZMEX</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_1u29yKxb</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:businessRuleTask id="riskClassification" name="Final Risk Classification">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_WuhSJujP</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NFb6OA8f</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:businessRuleTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="outcomeGateway" name="Classification Outcome?" default="Flow_y162Zfc7">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NFb6OA8f</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_hHN1OOEM</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_VHWI1YqZ</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_y162Zfc7</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="activateAccount" camunda:type="external" camunda:topic="account-activation-service" name="Activate Customer Account">
      <bpmn:extensionElements>
        <camunda:inputOutput>
          <camunda:inputParameter name="customerId">=applicant.id</camunda:inputParameter>
        </camunda:inputOutput>
      </bpmn:extensionElements>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_hHN1OOEM</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_1busQeAe</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="endApproved" name="Customer Approved">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_1busQeAe</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="escalateToCompliance" camunda:type="external" camunda:topic="compliance-escalation-service" name="Escalate to Compliance">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_VHWI1YqZ</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_KmLNM32V</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="endEscalated" name="Escalated to Compliance">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_KmLNM32V</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="sendFinalRejection" camunda:type="external" camunda:topic="email-sender" name="Send Rejection Notice">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_y162Zfc7</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_b0dqg7ck</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="endRejected" name="Customer Rejected">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_b0dqg7ck</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="dueDiligenceGateway_join">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Fj3alEoq</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_1u29yKxb</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_WuhSJujP</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_xMEWWQ9P" sourceRef="start" targetRef="uploadDocument"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_aFggSXlz" sourceRef="uploadDocument" targetRef="verifyDocument"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_nrWGBeCZ" sourceRef="verifyDocument" targetRef="qualityGateway"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Vp0HOfCz" sourceRef="qualityGateway" targetRef="screening" name="verification-passed">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">=verified = true</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RETXa3Vt" sourceRef="qualityGateway" targetRef="incrementRetry" name="verification-failed"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_i4OMbS2y" sourceRef="incrementRetry" targetRef="retryGateway"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_8reekDVI" sourceRef="retryGateway" targetRef="uploadDocument" name="retry-upload">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">=retryCount <= 2</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Y4q86h1Q" sourceRef="retryGateway" targetRef="sendVerificationRejection" name="retries-exhausted"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_VNppp5Gg" sourceRef="sendVerificationRejection" targetRef="endRejectedVerification"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_8ZqbzajU" sourceRef="screening" targetRef="dueDiligenceGateway"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_hyodCBEu" sourceRef="dueDiligenceGateway" targetRef="standardDueDiligence" name="standard-dd">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">=sanctionsHit = false and pep = false</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Fj3alEoq" sourceRef="standardDueDiligence" targetRef="dueDiligenceGateway_join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_LXaUZMEX" sourceRef="dueDiligenceGateway" targetRef="complianceReview" name="enhanced-dd"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_1u29yKxb" sourceRef="complianceReview" targetRef="dueDiligenceGateway_join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NFb6OA8f" sourceRef="riskClassification" targetRef="outcomeGateway"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_hHN1OOEM" sourceRef="outcomeGateway" targetRef="activateAccount" name="approved">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">=riskClassification.decision = "approve"</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_1busQeAe" sourceRef="activateAccount" targetRef="endApproved"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_VHWI1YqZ" sourceRef="outcomeGateway" targetRef="escalateToCompliance" name="escalated">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">=riskClassification.decision = "escalate"</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_KmLNM32V" sourceRef="escalateToCompliance" targetRef="endEscalated"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_y162Zfc7" sourceRef="outcomeGateway" targetRef="sendFinalRejection" name="rejected"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_b0dqg7ck" sourceRef="sendFinalRejection" targetRef="endRejected"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_WuhSJujP" sourceRef="dueDiligenceGateway_join" targetRef="riskClassification"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
